title: How Impulsiveness Influences Obesity: The Mediating Effect of Resting-State Brain Activity in the dlPFC.
supporting_sentence: We found that the right dlPFC completely mediated the relationship between non-planning impulsiveness and BMI.

title: Changes in ALFF and ReHo values in methamphetamine abstinent individuals based on the Harvard-Oxford atlas: A longitudinal resting-state fMRI study.
supporting_sentence: The changes in ALFF and ReHo in the right middle frontal gyrus were significantly associated with BIS total scores, BIS attention scores, and BIS nonplanning scores.
verifier_rationale: The sentence directly supports the association between impulsivity (general) and BOLD variability, with higher impulsivity scores being associated with higher BOLD variability in the right middle frontal gyrus.

title: Resting-state brain networks alterations in adolescents with Internet Gaming Disorder associate with cognitive control impairments.
supporting_sentence: In comparison to the control group, impulsivity in adolescent IGD subjects showed a positive correlation with the severity of IGD (r=0.6350, p < 0.001), linked to impairments in the Executive Control Network (ECN) and a decrease in functional connectivity between the Salience Network (SN) and ECN.
verifier_rationale: The sentence clearly supports the claim by stating a positive correlation between impulsivity and IGD severity, which is linked to impairments in the Executive Control Network and a decrease in functional connectivity between the Salience Network and ECN.
